Supreme Court Mandates BS-VI Vehicles in Delhi for Pollution Control

The Supreme Court has called for the exclusive use of Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) compliant vehicles within Delhi to combat air pollution. The court indicated a potential expansion of this mandate to the National Capital Region (NCR). Justice Joymalya Bagchi remarked on the current winter's relatively safe air quality, stating, "We are fortunate this winter. For now, people's lungs remain safe."
